info.title: hydromart-digital events for the AI web
info.description:
HD-7. Events hydromart-digital sends out, as signed HTTPS POSTs from admin-service. The AI web is the only receiver of these (its ingress route, then n8n); n8n has no public route (Plan Eksekusi section 4).

Registering: a SUPER_ADMIN adds the receiver URL and the event names at /hq/webhooks. The URL must be public HTTPS (a private or internal address is refused, at registration and again before every send). The signing secret is shown once, at registration; keep it in the receiver env. A secret is 32 to 200 printable characters; every endpoint has one, and every delivery is signed.

Verifying a delivery, in this order: (1) read the raw body bytes and verify those, never a re-serialised copy; (2) refuse when X-Hydromart-Timestamp is missing or more than 300 seconds from your own clock; (3) compute sha256= plus the lowercase hex HMAC-SHA256 of "<timestamp>.<raw body>" with the secret, and compare it with X-Hydromart-Signature in constant time; refuse a mismatch; (4) parse the JSON and dedupe on eventId: one event can arrive more than once (a retry after a slow answer, a replay from HQ), and a repeat is answered 2xx without doing the work again; (5) answer 2xx within 10 seconds and do slow work afterwards.

Retries: any answer other than 2xx, a redirect (never followed), a timeout over 10 seconds or a connection error is retried after 1, 5, 25, 125 and 625 minutes. After the 6th failed attempt the delivery is DEAD; HQ can send it again from /hq/webhooks. The producer keeps its own outbox, so an admin-service outage delays an event, it does not lose one.

Compatibility: receivers ignore fields they do not know. A field may be added within version 1; removing or renaming one is a new contract version.

The same signing applies to every event admin-service sends (delivery.delivered goes to partner integrations and is not part of this contract).

post.summary: A calon mitra submitted a franchise application on /waralaba
post.description:
Sent once per application, for applications submitted after this event was introduced (no backfill). The first workflow it feeds is AI-5: notify HQ and Sales.

It carries no personal data. Name, phone number, GPS location and amounts stay in hydromart-digital, on the application detail page /hq/applications/detail?id=<applicationId> (HEAD_OFFICE, DIREKTUR and SUPER_ADMIN). Moving the contact data into the AI web CRM is Tahap 2, after the /waralaba consent is stored (HD-8).

parameters.name: X-Hydromart-Event
parameters.description: The event name, the same as the body field event.

parameters.name: X-Hydromart-Delivery
parameters.description: The delivery id, the same as the body field id.

parameters.name: X-Hydromart-Timestamp
parameters.description: Unix time in seconds at which THIS attempt was sent. Part of the signed string.

parameters.name: X-Hydromart-Signature
parameters.description: sha256= followed by the lowercase hex HMAC-SHA256 of "<X-Hydromart-Timestamp>.<raw body>", keyed with the endpoint secret.

2XX.description: Taken (or already taken: a repeated eventId). The delivery is marked DELIVERED.

default.description: Anything else is retried (see info.description), and DEAD after the 6th failed attempt.

id.description: The delivery id: one per receiver endpoint, the same on its retries and replays. Not the dedupe key.

eventId.description: franchise.application_submitted:<applicationId>. The same on every retry, replay and producer re-send: the dedupe key.

city.description: City of the proposed depot, as the applicant typed it. Show it as text, never as markup.

province.description: Province of the proposed depot, as the applicant typed it.

x-hydromart-signature-test-vector.description: A receiver implementation must produce exactly this signature from these inputs. admin-service and depot-service tests read this block, so it cannot drift from the code.
